preset_chill_dinner_hint: In order of arrival. Only the host skips.
preset_house_party_hint: Everyone takes turns. Skips are voted.
preset_chaos_hint: Random order. Anyone skips, removes or jumps the queue.
nothing_playing: Nothing playing yet. Add the first song!
not_started: Waiting for the host to start the party.
no_player: No device is playing right now.
add_placeholder: Paste a link or search for a song
no_results: Nothing found. Try other words, or paste a link.
confirm_hint: For “{title}”. The first one stays unless you pick another in {seconds} s.
governance_anarchy: Anarchy (anyone can skip, remove or jump the queue)
governance_full_democracy: Full democracy (the host votes like everyone)
allow_collections: Let guests add whole albums and playlists
prefer_audio: Play the audio version of pasted music videos
approve_joins: Let in each new guest yourself
same_network_hint: New guests on mobile data or a VPN won't get in, and now and then someone on your Wi-Fi might not either.
waiting_approval: Hi {name}! Waiting for the host to let you in…
max_queued: Songs one guest can have waiting
add_cooldown_wait: You can add another song in {seconds} s.
player_start_hint: Keep this screen on and this tab in front while the party is on.
player_not_allowed: Only the host or a co-host can play the music.
share_no_party: Join a party first, then share the song again.
share_no_link: There was no song link in what you shared.
error_bad_code: That code isn't valid. Check the screen for the current one.
error_banned: You were removed from this party.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
error_not_allowed: You can't do that in this party.
error_unresolvable: Couldn't find that song. Try another link.
error_collection: This party only takes single songs. The host can allow albums and playlists.
error_matching_unavailable: Can't look that song up right now. Paste a YouTube link instead.
error_too_long: That one is too long for this party.
error_queue_limit: You have enough songs queued. Wait for one to play.
error_cooldown: Wait a little before adding another song.
error_locked: This party isn't taking new guests.
error_other_network: Connect to the host's Wi-Fi to join this party.
